classification.difficultyReason: Form and combine perimeter and area equations to eliminate the angle, solve the resulting quadratic exactly, and reject a positive root because its angle exceeds a full turn.

content.prompt: A sector has perimeter $24+2\pi\text{ cm}$ and area $12\pi\text{ cm}^2$. Find the radius $r$ and the angle $\theta$. Give exact answers, with $\theta$ in radians.

answer.short:
$r=12\text{ cm}$, $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ radians.

Combine $P=2r+r\theta$ and $A=\tfrac12r^2\theta$. Reject $r=\pi\text{ cm}$ because it gives $\theta>2\pi$.
answer.worked:
For a sector, $0<\theta<2\pi$. The perimeter and area give
$$\begin{align*}2r+r\theta&=24+2\pi\\r\theta&=24+2\pi-2r\\\tfrac12r^2\theta&=12\pi\\r^2\theta&=24\pi.\end{align*}$$
Substitute the expression for $r\theta$:
$$\begin{align*}r(24+2\pi-2r)&=24\pi\\r^2-(12+\pi)r+12\pi&=0\\(r-12)(r-\pi)&=0.\end{align*}$$
Thus $r=12$ or $r=\pi$. If $r=\pi$, then $\theta=\frac{24}{\pi}>2\pi$, so this root cannot represent the sector. Hence $r=12\text{ cm}$ and
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\frac{24\pi}{12^2}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{6}\text{ radians}.\end{align*}$$
